ruleset.name: Web-CAT migrated ruleset
ruleset.description: Rules previously handled by Checkstyle and migrated to PMD. The original policy is preserved while whitespace responsibilities are composed from independent operator, delimiter, and brace rules.

rule.name: LineLength
rule.description: Prevent unnecessarily long lines in source code.

property.name: message
property.value: This line is longer than {0} characters. Break it into multiple lines so that it is easier to read.

rule.message: Constants should be names in ALL_CAPITALS, with words separated by underscores. Non-constant fields should be named in camelCase, starting with a lowercase letter.
Method names should be in camelCase, starting with a lowercase letter.
Method parameter names should be in camelCase, starting with a lowercase letter.
Local variable names should be in camelCase, starting with a lowercase letter.
Class, interface, enum, and annotation names should be in PascalCase, starting with an uppercase letter.
Type parameter names should be in PascalCase, starting with an uppercase letter. By convention, single-letter type parameters are often used, but they should still be uppercase.

This statement is just a '';'' and, therefore, does nothing. You may have added a '';'' in an inappropriate location (like after an if or a for loop). See if you are missing code or just delete the extra '';''.

Strings should be compared using equals(). The == and != operators compare the references of objects, not their values. Using the equals() (or equalsIgnoreCase()) method will compare the values of the Strings instead.

rule.name: UpperEll
rule.description: Prevent long literals that end with a lowercase 'l', which can be easily confused with the digit '1'.

property.name: message
property.value: When declaring a literal long value, use an uppercase ''L'' instead of a lowercase ''l''. This avoids the confusion between the lowercase ''l'' (ell) and the number ''1''.

rule.name: StrictJavadoc
rule.description: Enforce the explicitly selected declaration coverage and Javadoc tag policy.

property.name: missingJavadocMessage
property.value: {0} ''{1}'' is missing a Javadoc comment.

property.name: malformedParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has a malformed @param tag with no parameter name.

property.name: duplicateParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has duplicate @param for parameter ''{2}''.

property.name: unknownParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has @param for unknown parameter ''{2}''.

property.name: duplicateTypeParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has duplicate @param for type parameter ''{2}''.

property.name: unknownTypeParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has @param for unknown type parameter ''{2}''.

property.name: missingParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' is missing @param for ''{2}''.

property.name: missingTypeParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' is missing @param for type parameter ''{2}''.

property.name: duplicateReturnMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has duplicate @return tags.

property.name: missingReturnMessage
property.value: Javadoc for non-void method ''{0}'' must declare @return.

property.name: forbiddenReturnMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' must not declare @return.

property.name: malformedTypeParamMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has a malformed @param tag with no target.

property.name: invalidTypeParamTargetMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has invalid @param target ''{2}''.

property.name: unusedTagOnTypeMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' contains unused @{2} tag.

property.name: missingAuthorMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' must declare @author.

property.name: duplicateAuthorMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has duplicate @author tags.

property.name: emptyAuthorMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has an empty @author tag.

property.name: missingVersionMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' must declare @version.

property.name: duplicateVersionMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has duplicate @version tags.

property.name: emptyVersionMessage
property.value: Javadoc for {0} ''{1}'' has an empty @version tag.

property.name: missingFieldJavadocMessage
property.value: Non-private field(s) ''{0}'' must have Javadoc.

rule.name: IndentationRule
rule.description: Infer each file's indentation unit and enforce it consistently. Tabs are not allowed in indentation.

property.name: tabViolationMessage
property.value: Line {0} contains a tab character. Use spaces for indentation.

property.name: indentViolationMessage
property.value: Line {0} is indented incorrectly. Expected {1} spaces but found {2}.

property.name: inconsistentFileMessage
property.value: This file does not follow a consistent indentation style. Each line must be indented with a number of spaces that is a multiple of the indent size of your choosing. I.e. 2 or 4 spaces per level.

rule.name: OperatorSpacing
rule.message: Use consistent whitespace around operators and control-flow keywords.
rule.description: Check unary, binary, ternary, and keyword spacing.

rule.name: DelimiterSpacing
rule.description: Check separators, method parentheses, generic delimiters, and member-access dots.

rule.name: LineLayout
rule.description: Enforce at most one statement per physical line.

rule.name: RightCurlyBlock
rule.description: Enforce that a right curly brace is alone on its physical line.

rule.message: Comments should not contain TODO or FIX ME (FIXME) tags. This indicates unfinished code that should probably be addressed.

property.name: forbiddenRegex
property.value: (?i)\b(?:TODO|FIXME|FIX ME)\b

property.name: pattern
property.value: ^\s*\*\s*(Write|Place) a.*here\.\s*$

property.name: message
property.value: This is a placeholder and should be replaced.

rule.name: RegexReplaceThisPreventer
rule.description: Prevent "Replace this comment with your own" placeholders.

property.name: pattern
property.value: ^\s*\*\s*Replace this.*with your own\.\s*$

property.name: message
property.value: This is a placeholder and should be replaced.

rule.name: RegexAuthorPartnerPreventer
rule.description: Prevent placeholder partner names in @author tags.

property.name: pattern
property.value: ^\s*\*\s*@author\s+Partner( [1-9])?'s\s+name

property.name: message
property.value: This is a placeholder and should be replaced.

property.name: message
property.value: This is a placeholder and should be replaced.

property.name: pattern
property.value: ^\s*\*\s*@version.*place the date here\b

property.name: message
property.value: This is a placeholder and should be replaced.

rule.name: JavaStyleArrayDeclarationRule
rule.description: Enforce Java-style array declarations, such as int[] x instead of int x[].

property.name: variableMessage
property.value: Array brackets should be on the type, not the variable: {0}. For example, use ''int[] x'' instead of ''int x[]''.

property.name: methodMessage
property.value: Array brackets should be on the return type, not after the parameter list: {0}. For example, use ''int[] foo()'' instead of ''int foo()[]''.

rule.message: Avoid assigning values to variables as part of a larger expression. It is difficult to read correctly and may cause confusion. Make each assignment a separate statement.
To make the code more readable, place each variable or field in its own declaration on a separate line.

rule.name: HiddenFieldRule
rule.description: Prevent method parameters and local variables from having the same name as a field in the same class.

property.name: parameterMessage
property.value: ''{0}'' has the same name as one of the class's fields. This is generally confusing and should be avoided. Rename the parameter or local variable so that there is no conflict.

property.name: localVariableMessage
property.value: ''{0}'' has the same name as one of the class's fields. This is generally confusing and should be avoided. Rename the parameter or local variable so that there is no conflict.

rule.message: The case above will fall through and run the code in this case too. This may be an indication that a break statement is missing at the end of the previous case. If this is the intended functionality, add a comment on the last line of the previous case with the phrase ''fallthrough'' to indicate that.

rule.name: FieldVisibilityRule
rule.description: Enforce that fields have appropriate visibility modifiers.

property.name: missingModifierMessage
property.value: Field ''{0}'' is missing a visibility modifier.

property.name: publicFieldMessage
property.value: The field ''{0}'' should be declared private. Only constants (static final fields) are allowed to be public. If this field is intended to represent a constant value, declare it to be static and final.

property.name: protectedFieldMessage
property.value: Field ''{0}'' should be private instead of protected.

rule.name: CovariantEqualsRule
rule.description: Require equals(Object) when a class declares a covariant equals overload.

property.name: violationMessage
property.value: This class defines a ''covariant'' equals() method (i.e., where the argument is the same type as this class), but it does not override the method equals(Object). Mistakenly defining equals() with the wrong parameter type is an error that can produce unexpected run-time behavior. Add a meaningful definition for equals(Object), or correct your existing equals() method.
